fn ov_driver_exports(cli:*CCli, overloads:*OvStage)->bool {
    var context:*RmdContext = (*overloads).context;
    var index:usize = 0usize;
    while index < (*cli).export_count {
        var text:*u8 = (*cli).exports[index];
        var name:*RmdName = ov_intern(overloads, text, c_length(text));
        if (*overloads).failed { return false; }
        var group:*OvGlobal = ov_global(overloads, name);
        if group == null(*OvGlobal) {
            return c_driver_error(&(*cli).driver, "exported source declaration was not found");
        }
        if ov_reserved(text) {
            return c_driver_error(&(*cli).driver, "export uses the reserved overload symbol prefix");
        }
        if (*group).count > 1usize {
            return c_driver_error(&(*cli).driver, "--export is ambiguous for an overload family; define a named wrapper");
        }
        if (*group).first != null(*OvFunction) { name = (*(*group).first).internal_name; }
        var symbol:*RmdSymbol = rmd_map_get(&(*context).globals, name as usize) as *RmdSymbol;
        var declaration:*RmdDecl = (*symbol).decl;
        if (*declaration).kind != RMD_D_FUNCTION && (*declaration).kind != RMD_D_CONST {
            return c_driver_error(&(*cli).driver, "--export requires a defined function or constant");
        }
        (*declaration).link_name = (*(*group).name).text;
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    return true;
}

fn ov_driver_entry(cli:*CCli, overloads:*OvStage)->*RmdDecl {
    var name:*RmdName = ov_intern(overloads, (*cli).entry_name, c_length((*cli).entry_name));
    if (*overloads).failed { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    var group:*OvGlobal = ov_global(overloads, name);
    if group == null(*OvGlobal) || (*group).first == null(*OvFunction) {
        c_driver_error(&(*cli).driver, "entry function was not found");
        return null(*RmdDecl);
    }
    var loc:RmdLoc = (*(*group).declaration).loc;
    var syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(overloads, RMD_T_FUNCTION, &loc);
    var integer:*RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(overloads, RMD_T_I32, &loc);
    var byte:*RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(overloads, RMD_T_U8, &loc);
    var pointer:*RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(overloads, RMD_T_POINTER, &loc);
    var pointers:*RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(overloads, RMD_T_POINTER, &loc);
    var parameters:**RmdTypeSyntax = ov_alloc(overloads, 2usize * sizeof(*RmdTypeSyntax), alignof(*RmdTypeSyntax)) as **RmdTypeSyntax;
    if (*overloads).failed { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    (*pointer).base = byte;
    (*pointers).base = pointer;
    parameters[0usize] = integer;
    parameters[1usize] = pointers;
    (*syntax).params = parameters;
    (*syntax).param_count = 2usize;
    (*syntax).base = integer;
    var selected:*OvFunction = ov_select(overloads, group, syntax, false, &loc);
    if selected == null(*OvFunction) { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    var symbol:*RmdSymbol = rmd_map_get(&(*(*overloads).context).globals, (*selected).internal_name as usize) as *RmdSymbol;
    if (*(*symbol).decl).kind != RMD_D_FUNCTION {
        c_driver_error(&(*cli).driver, "entry must be a defined fn(i32, **u8) -> i32");
        return null(*RmdDecl);
    }
    return (*symbol).decl;
}

fn ov_driver_build(cli:*CCli, overloads:*OvStage,
    reader:fn(*OvStage,*RmdSource,usize,usize)->bool,
    prepare:fn(*OvStage)->bool, body:fn(*CStage,*RmdDecl,*u8)->bool, user:*u8)->i32 {
    var context:*RmdContext = (*overloads).context;
    if (*cli).root != null(*RmdSource) &&
       !reader(overloads, (*cli).root, (*cli).target_begin, (*(*cli).root).size) { return 1i32; }
    var index:usize = 0usize;
    while index < (*cli).source_count {
        var source:*RmdSource = &(*cli).sources[index];
        var bytes:*u8 = null(*u8);
        var size:usize = 0usize;
        if rmd0_host_read_file((*source).path, &bytes, &size) != 0i32 {
            c_driver_io_error(&(*cli).driver, "cannot read input", (*source).path, *c_driver_errno());
            return 1i32;
        }
        (*source).bytes = rmd_try_copy_string(context, bytes, size);
        (*source).size = size;
        rmd0_host_free(bytes);
        if (*source).bytes == null(*u8) { return 1i32; }
        if !reader(overloads, source, 0usize, size) { return 1i32; }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    if !prepare(overloads) || !ov_driver_exports(cli, overloads) { return 1i32; }
    if (*cli).mode == 3u32 { return 0i32; }
    if !c_driver_names(&(*cli).driver) { return 1i32; }
    var entry:*RmdDecl = null(*RmdDecl);
    if !(*cli).library {
        entry = ov_driver_entry(cli, overloads);
        if entry == null(*RmdDecl) { return 1i32; }
    }
    if (*cli).mode == 4u32 {
        if c_emit_with_body(&(*cli).stage, entry, body, user) { return 0i32; }
        return 1i32;
    }
    return c_backend_build_with_body(context, entry, &(*cli).options, body, user);
}

fn ov_check(stage:*OvStage)->bool {
    if !ov_prepare(stage) { return false; }
    var context:*RmdContext = (*stage).context;
    return rmd_collect(context) && rmd_resolve(context) && rmd_check(context);
}

// Require an empty initialized context and source storage live through its destruction.
// Complete the requested output. Retain diagnostics without printing them.
fn overload_program(request:*RmdBuild)->i32 {
    var cli:CCli = uninit;
    var context:*RmdContext = (*request).context;
    var success:bool = c_driver_init(&cli, context, (*request).argc);
    cli.root = (*request).source;
    cli.target_begin = (*request).target_begin;
    var overloads:OvStage = uninit;
    ov_init(&overloads, context, "rmd0_x64_v1", null(*OvHooks));
    var result:i32 = 1i32;
    if success && c_driver_parse(&cli, (*request).argc, (*request).argv, 0i32) {
        result = ov_driver_build(&cli, &overloads, ov_read, ov_check,
            null(fn(*CStage,*RmdDecl,*u8)->bool), null(*u8));
    }
    c_stage_destroy(&cli.stage);
    return result;
}

// Compile the retained source from begin through EOF, print failures, and release its context.
fn overload_build(source:*RmdSource, begin:usize, argc:i32, argv:**u8)->i32 {
    var context:RmdContext = uninit;
    rmd_context_init(&context, null(*RmdAllocator));
    var request:RmdBuild = make RmdBuild {
        context:&context, source:source, target_begin:begin, argc:argc, argv:argv
    };
    var result:i32 = overload_program(&request);
    if context.error_count != 0usize { c_driver_diagnostic(&context); }
    rmd_context_destroy(&context);
    return result;
}
